_doc: Fixed parameters of suzume (not options), embedded at build time (src/rust/suzume/params.rs); every key is required.

dp._doc: max_shanten: the DP values hands at or below this shanten; ron_rate: scale on the chance an opponent discard is a winning tile; riichi_deposit: the riichi stick's cost when the hand does not win.

value_features._doc: Linear value score of a discard (rules::value_features): picks the discard after a call outside the DP's range.

tile_features._doc: Tie pick among discards within tie_band of the best value score (rules::tile_features::tie_pick).

context._doc: A unique top leads by more than top_margin (the outside bias of suzume-mlp1).
